sql:
SELECT
    toMonth(DateKey) AS MonthNumber,
    formatDateTime(DateKey, '%B') AS MonthName,
    sum(SalesAmount) AS MonthlySales,
    sum(sum(SalesAmount)) OVER (ORDER BY toMonth(DateKey) ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS CumulativeSales
FROM retail.FactSales
WHERE toYear(DateKey) = 2009
GROUP BY MonthNumber, MonthName
ORDER BY MonthNumber
